summary: A hospital’s application for a new payment program waits until another office clears its admissions practices.
realLife: Federal health officials made Title VI compliance a condition of hospital certification for Medicare.
gates: The program ties participation to civil rights compliance.
inGame: Coverage records identify Medicare beneficiaries. needs: a separate certification decision for each hospital.

turns.what: Inspectors clear the hospital in time for its first Medicare patients.
turns.pulledBy: Interviews and admissions records confirm equal access.
turns.writesBack: The hospital enters the program on opening day.

turns.what: The hospital earns clearance after its first application stalls.
turns.pulledBy: A return inspection confirms the hospital has changed how it assigns beds.
turns.writesBack: The certification carries the later effective date.
